verdict.rationale: llamafile runs an LLM locally and offline, so you can get AI-generated answers about data you supply: prompts through the CLI or web chat UI, images via `/upload` with multimodal models, and audio transcription via whisperfile. However, there is no built-in way to ingest or analyze your own datasets or documents and surface insights. A community user notes that document-based use needs a separate LlamaIndex/Python setup. Missing for 10: built-in data/document ingestion or RAG, proactive insight or suggestion features, and hands-on evidence of data-analysis workflows.
